status: draft; disabled by default; no production migration or SMTP configuration performed
registration: Email-only request; a hashed single-use 15-minute token permits choosing a password and creating a NEW user only. Existing preregistered, invited and Google users are never claimed. No existing workspace membership is inherited.
passwords: scrypt N=131072 r=8 p=1; random 16-byte salt; 64-byte key; maximum two concurrent KDFs per process; persistent global and address rate limits before KDF; 12..128 characters
sessions: 7-day opaque 256-bit token in HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie, Secure and __Host prefix in production. Only SHA256 digest stored. Rotation on login; reset revokes local and Google sessions; logout clears both provider sessions. Conflicting identities fail closed.
migration: Adds five auth tables and a unique lower(btrim(email)) index. Audit duplicate normalized legacy User emails before separately approved production migration. Duplicates fail migration; no automatic reconciliation. CI exercises migration chain on disposable PostgreSQL then schema push.
email: Nodemailer requires configured canonical HTTPS app origin, authenticated SMTP on 465 or STARTTLS-required 587 with certificate validation. No transport credentials configured. Tests inject fake mail. Public requests durably queue an identical command for all addresses; account lookup and SMTP run in Next after(). Authenticated POST /api/cron/local-auth-mail retries durable jobs with a two-minute lease and 15-minute expiry. Scheduler must be configured separately before enabling; none was created. At-least-once SMTP may resend after an ambiguous delivery failure; verification remains single-use. Verification token stays in URL fragment and is removed from history on client mount.
readiness: AUTH_LOCAL_ENABLED=false by default. Separate approval is needed to configure deployment secrets, enable SMTP and run production migration. Existing Google sign-in remains available. A local-only account cannot reset a legacy Google/invited account.
retention: Authenticated outbox drain prunes expired jobs/challenges/rate limits/local sessions; separately configured invocation is required. Do not log raw tokens, passwords or email bodies.
evidence: Old Mac patch unavailable; these are regression scenarios against a clean implementation, not a claim to have reproduced its original code. Local Prisma checksum endpoint returned HTTP403; no bypass. Full Prisma/typecheck/database/build results are recorded in the draft PR CI.
